instruction: In apps/server/src/services/github-device-core.ts, when GitHub returns error: "incorrect_client_credentials" (even inside an HTTP 200 response) during token refresh, refreshGithubDeviceToken treats it as a temporary 502 error instead of a terminal 401 requiring reconnection. Classify incorrect_client_credentials as HttpError 401 with "GitHub authorization expired; reconnect GitHub" while preserving temporary failures.
